text: About a third of U.S. college students had no sexual partners in the past 12 months.

room.label: 5C students
room.note: HUMAN: campus set — fill from the 5C survey. A University of Missouri brief found 76% of students had 0–1 partners but only 16% thought their peers did.

truthSource.label: ACHA-NCHA II, Spring 2019 Reference Group
truthSource.oneLine: VERIFY in PDF: 33.1% of students reported no sexual partners in the last 12 months (n=67,972).
